headline: The fix holds. liveProvable now states three observed moments including the retained recheck, and no longer asserts 'only at' the two 12:36 moments; the recheck was not deleted to hide the old contradiction - its timestamps, exit code, 5/5 and pageCount are byte-identical to the pre-fix blob and only its note text was rewritten. healthIsNotLivenessProof carries every element the task demanded, including the half that matters most (/health still reporting edaConnected:true). The old a-verdict, sourceOfTwo false, overall string, 18/18/3/d224/+16 and the withdrawn-object-mismatch record are all intact. The three live timestamps match the synced guide verbatim. Two info-level blemishes, neither of which changes a conclusion: the third local timestamp is 4 ms off its UTC conversion, and one provenance sentence is slightly loose about which observation corroborated what.

observationTimeArithmetic.finding: the third local timestamp is 4 ms away from its UTC counterpart's exact +08 conversion
observationTimeArithmetic.likelyCause: the third moment's UTC was taken from t53's output and its local from a second clock read, so the two are independent samples rather than a conversion
observationTimeArithmetic.impact: none on any conclusion - it does not touch which moments were observed or what was seen; it is a rounding/transcription artifact
observationTimeArithmetic.whyIAmNotUnilaterallyFixingIt: correcting it means editing both r7t5 (j5's file) and the guide (mine), and the two must stay byte-identical per the task; a one-sided fix would create exactly the kind of cross-artifact mismatch this review is meant to catch

overall.why: Every item passes on its own terms. The specific hazards were: (i) dropping 'only' while keeping two timestamps - avoided, three timestamps were added; (ii) deleting the recheck to erase the contradiction - avoided, all five substantive fields are identical to the pre-fix blob and only the note was rewritten to agree with the new claim; (iii) recording the disconnected failure without the '/health still says true' half - avoided, that half is present with count 1 and pendingRequests 1. The old verdict surface is intact, including the retraction verbatim. The numbers in the artifact reproduce when I recount t31 myself. The three live timestamps match the guide character-for-character, and the guide edit was mine (6d0ddba) rather than something t1 slipped in.
infoLevelFindings: third local timestamp is 4 ms off the exact +08 conversion (recorded 218, arithmetic gives 222); consistent across both artifacts, conclusion-neutral

healthIsNotLivenessProof.evidenceOrigin calls r8t9 a corroboration 'at that timestamp'; r8t9's /execute read was a separate, unstamped observation of the same window and error string - 'in kind' is right, 'at that timestamp' is loose
overall.whatIWouldAskBeforeCallingItPerfect: reconcile the 4 ms pair once, in one place, so r7t5 and the guide keep the same strings and neither carries an avoidable arithmetic blemish
